updates.note: Management updated the camera module capacity expansion target to around 180 million units to 190 million units annually over the next 15 to 18 months.
updates.quote: expanding the capacities of camera module and a subsidiary Q Tech... from 70 million units annually to around 180 million units to 190 million units annually over the next 15 to 18 months

updates.note: Reiterated IT products revenue to be more than INR4,000 crores in the current fiscal.
updates.quote: revenue in this fiscal is going to be more than INR4,000 crores.

updates.note: Display module facility trial start delayed to Q3 of current fiscal.
updates.quote: trials will start from beginning of Q3 and mass production will commence from end of Q3, beginning of Q4 this fiscal.

updates.note: Reiterated fully automatic front-loading washing machine launch by end of Q2 with 0.3 million units capacity.
updates.quote: fully automatic front-loading washing machine, which will be launched by end of Q2 this financial year.

updates.note: Capex for fiscal FY26 was reported at INR1,058 crores.
updates.quote: after doing a capex of almost INR1,058 crores

new_promises.statement: Telecom network business to target INR7,500 crores to INR8,000 crores in FY27.
new_promises.quote: We are targeting almost INR7,500 crores, INR8,000 crores in '26, '27.
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall

new_promises.statement: Lighting segment next year target is almost INR1,700 crores.
new_promises.quote: The next year target is almost INR1,700 crores.
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall

new_promises.statement: Camera module business targeting a revenue of almost INR2,500 crores.
new_promises.quote: We are targeting a revenue of almost INR2,500 crores in that business.
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall
